vocab.example_vi: Có nguy cơ trễ deadline nếu hôm nay chúng ta không có dữ liệu.

vocab.example: We're running behind because of the extra requests.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi đang bị chậm tiến độ vì có thêm yêu cầu.

vocab.meaning_vi: ngày dự phòng thêm vào lịch trình
vocab.example: Let's add a buffer day in case something else comes up.

vocab.meaning_vi: nhận quá nhiều việc so với khả năng

vocab.example: We need to renegotiate the deadline with the client.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: Minh, how is the report coming along? The deadline is tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Actually, I think we have a missed deadline risk. The data isn't ready yet.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: That's concerning. Can you tell me why you're running behind?

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: I overcommitted to too many tasks this month.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: I understand. Let's renegotiate the deadline with the client.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Thank you. A two-day extension would really help.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: Okay, I'll ask for two more days. Please give me a realistic estimate this time.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: I will. Let's also add a buffer day in case something else comes up.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: Good idea. Can you send me the revised timeline by tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Sure, I'll prepare it tonight and share it first thing tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Project Manager)
lines.text: Perfect. If we stay on track, we can still deliver on time.

lines.speaker: Minh (Employee)
lines.text: Understood. I'll update you every day so there are no surprises.

questions.q: Why is Minh running behind on the report?
options: He overcommitted to too many tasks

options: Renegotiate the deadline with the client

options: A buffer day and a revised timeline
